patch_list: Stops the app sending you to the Play Store on startup because it wasn't installed from Play. Needed for any patched build to open.
Darkens the app by inverting its colours (hues are kept). Choose Auto (follow the phone), Always dark, or Off. Note: brand colours look lighter, and photos and QR codes are inverted too.
